connector.name: Ocultar Pii
connector.registryDescription: Zero-egress PII redaction for Claude. Runs locally - no data leaves your infrastructure.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ocultar-claude-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the edu963 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OCULTAR_URL
env.description: URL of your locally running Ocultar Refinery

env.name: OCULTAR_API_KEY
env.description: Ocultar API key (leave blank if not configured)

env.name: OCULTAR_AUDITOR_TOKEN
env.description: Enables reveal_tokens tool. Must match OCU_AUDITOR_TOKEN on the server.
